title: Design: New Vendor starts on COD with the shop's own terms
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has a term of its own and uses Due on Receipt as the default, and you compare New Vendor with the design.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due 10 days after the invoice date.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-29 Ten.
  • Due on Receipt is the default for new customers.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design pictures ct-p7-01-new-vendor-today.png, ct-p7-02-new-vendor-starts-on-cod-picker-with-your-terms.png are attached to this case; open each at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the Vendors page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Vendor".
  2. Click the "Credit Terms" box.
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Vendor" window opens with "Credit Terms" reading COD and "Credit Limit" reading "$ 0.00", editable, side by side (as in ct-p7-02-new-vendor-starts-on-cod-picker-with-your-terms.png; compare today's ct-p7-01-new-vendor-today.png).
  • Step 2: the list shows the active terms in the page's order with {Term-A} among the Net terms, and no row has a "Default" pill.
  • Step 3: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S6-R1: “The Credit Terms dropdown on New Vendor and Edit Vendor lists the shop's active terms, standard and its own, in the S1-R5 order.”
  • S6-R2: “New Vendor starts on COD, as today. The shop's default does not apply to vendors, and the vendor dropdown shows no "Default" tag.”
  • S6-R4: “Vendor credit limits behave exactly as today on every term, COD and Credit Hold included: no lock, no $0 rule.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
